title: FlowFields with same filters and table in a single OUTER APPLY
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2 optimizes SmartSQL by combining multiple FlowFields with identical table filters into a single OUTER APPLY statement, reducing SQL queries and improving query performance. This enhancement matters for applications with many FlowFields querying the same data pool.
key_points: FlowFields sharing the same table and filters now consolidate into one OUTER APPLY instead of separate ones, eliminating redundant data retrieval
SmartSQL automatically groups SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX, EXISTS, and LOOKUP aggregations when they target the same data
This optimization is enabled by default in version 27.0 and has no configuration needed
Indexed views (V-SIFTs) are excluded from grouping to maintain their specialized behavior
The feature reduces network chatter and improves execution plans, with measurable impact on telemetry signals like page views and long-running query traces

quotes.text: A good platform feature, then, that is turned always on by default since 27.0.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms the feature requires no configuration and is automatically active
